svg.title: Normalized convex generators of four power divergences
svg.desc: All curves have value and slope zero at one, and second derivative one there. The generators for reverse KL, twice squared Hellinger, KL and half Pearson chi-square differ away from one.

g.text: φ(1) = φ′(1) = 0 and φ″(1) = 1: the same local geometry, different tails.
